transport._note: Protocol constants, not a per-model interface inventory. Which of these a box actually answers on is measured by the discovery sweep and recorded in the family probe file.

raw_socket.description: Bare SCPI over TCP. No session layer, no discovery.

hislip.description: IVI HiSLIP. Carries SRQ and device clear, unlike the raw socket.

vxi11.description: SUNRPC portmapper only; the core channel port is negotiated per session.

telnet.description: Human-facing SCPI prompt. Echoes and prints a banner — do not parse.

verb_mapping.get: Single-value queries (each one also a NAB)
verb_mapping.set: Single parameter mutation and write commands
verb_mapping.nab: Observation and telemetry acquisition queries — anything that returns more than one thing is a NAB only
verb_mapping.do: Zero-argument execution actions and trigger commands

Get_Display_Window_Status.description: This command turns the power module optional front panel voltage and current displays on and off

Get_Output_Relay_Status.description: This command is valid only if the power module is configured for the optional relay connector

Get_Output_Ttltrg_Status.description: This command enables or disables the power module Trigger Out signal, which is available at a BNC connector on the rear of the mainframe

Get_Output_Dfi_Link.description: This command specifies which events within the power module are linked to DFI source events

Get_Output_Dfi_Source.description: This command selects the source for DFI events

Get_Output_Dfi_Status.description: This command enables or disables the discrete fault indicator (DFI) signal to the power module backplane

Get_Output_Relay_Polarity.description: This command is valid only if the power module is configured for the optional relay connector

Get_Output_Status.description: If the power module is configured to use the relay option, the command opens the relay contacts when the output is disabled and closes them when it is enabled

Get_Source_Current_Level_Immediate_Ampli.description: Get source current level immediate amplitude

Get_Source_Current_Level_Trigger_Amplitu.description: Get source current level trigger amplitude

Get_Source_List_Dwel.description: - If LIST:STEP ONCE has been programmed, the output remains at the present level until a trigger sequences the next point in the list

Get_Source_List_Step.description: In either mode, triggers that occur during a dwell interval are ignored

Get_Source_Voltage_Level_Trigger_Amplitu.description: Get source voltage level trigger amplitude

Get_Source_Current_Mode.description: LIST:CURR . If the LIST parameter is used, then the output current may be changed by the subsequent execution of a list

Get_Source_Current_Protection_Status.description: This command enables or disables the power module overcurrent (OC) protection function

Get_Source_List_Count.description: This command sets the number of times that the list is executed before it is completed

Get_Source_List_Current_Points.description: This query returns the number of points specified in LIST:CURR

Get_Source_List_Dwfl_Points.description: This query returns the number of points specified in LIST:DWEL

Get_Source_List_Voltage_Points.description: This query returns the number of points specified in LIST:VOLT

Get_Source_Voltage_Mode.description: LIST:VOLT . If the LIST parameter is used, then the output voltage may be changed by the subsequent execution of a list

Get_Source_Voltage_Sense_Source.description: This command reads the state of the power module output connector remote sense switch

Get_Souri_Voltage_Level_Immediate_Amplit.description: Get souri voltage level immediate amplitude
